The '''Luxiar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Bon'nyuw-Luq sector/Legends|Bon'nyuw-Luq sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Luxiar 7]].
